acceptance_tier: LOCAL functional check on the recorded rig and mount session; not an independent accuracy tier.

source_data.path: mid360s_d435i_20260919_050305.bag (2.3 GB, lz4; not in repo)
source_data.delivery_audit: 0 dropped, 0 out-of-order on all three topics; max inter-message gap 101.7 / 7.9 / 68.4 ms

local_changes: livox_ros_driver -> livox_ros_driver2 CustomMsg (8 sites); MID-360S requires driver2
imu/imu_int_frame 30 -> 400 (0.15 s -> 2 s static gravity init)
preprocess/first_echo_only=true: drop 1st/2nd returns (glass produces 15% multi-return vs 2.3% normally)
implementation.config_generator: gen_config_from_calib.py reads results/*.json; no hand-copied numbers

extrin_calib/Rcl,Pcl.note: FAST-LIVO2 composes Rci = Rcl*Rli, i.e. Rcl/Pcl is T_camera_lidar; same convention, used verbatim

time_offset/img_time_offset_s.derivation: FAST-LIVO2 uses t = stamp + img_time_offset; calibration convention t_depth = t_lidar + off -> img_time_offset = -off/1000 = +0.005989
time_offset/img_time_offset_s.caveat: offset was calibrated for the depth stream; color stream may carry an extra few ms

live_run.mode: hand-held indoor loop, sensors on host, SLAM in container

replay_experiments.note: Same bag, same config. 3x replay dropped no frames; rviz ran in software GL (~5 cores) plus concurrent rosbag record. Trajectories agree to within 0.15 m -> algorithm is deterministic on this input and compute headroom >= 3x.

criteria: all three replays: effective/downsampled ratio never < 30%
end pose within 2.2 m of start over a 27 m walk in a ~2x3 m room
no divergence with or without rviz/recording load
known_failure_modes_observed_live: glass/windows: multi-return geometry conflict -> mitigated by first_echo_only
all points within ~2 m (device set down / occluded) -> degenerate, diverges; not recoverable (no relocalisation in FAST-LIVO2)
IMU init while moving -> wrong gravity -> quadratic position runaway

render.tool: headless numpy/PIL from /cloud_registered + /aft_mapped_to_init recorded during the 1x replay; camera inset from the source bag
